content: Overview The following sections provide detailed, structured template statements for each micro-chapter page. Historical Perspective If the circumstances surrounding the discovery of the disease are known: The disease was first identified by [researcher/scientist] in [year] during [specific event or context]. Additional sentences may describe the development of diagnostic techniques or therapies, historical outbreaks or epidemics, discoveries related to the pathogenesis or causes of the disease, and other relevant historical milestones. Examples: In [year], [diagnostic technique/therapy] was developed by [researcher/institution] to treat or diagnose [disease]. There have been several notable outbreaks of [disease], which are summarized below. The association between [factor A] and [factor B] was first established in [year]. In [year], [researcher] was the first to discover the link between [factor] and the development of [disease]. In [year], mutations in [gene] were first implicated in the pathogenesis of [disease]. The following are a few famous cases of [disease]. For more detailed instructions on editing the historical perspective page, click [here]. To copy the template before editing, click [here]. Each stage is assigned a [specific designation] that reflects [specific characteristics]. If no staging system exists for the malignant disease: There is no established system for staging [disease].
